projectRequirement: All native BG3 gameplay capabilities reachable from replaced controller actions must remain available; UI editing/layout is excluded by explicit product policy.
coverageRules: Source command presence alone is not gameplay execution proof
Native game's own input globally available outside the CAM menu can satisfy an action only when the exact engine transport is proven
Each dynamic action class must be covered by BG3-owned VMHotBarSlot or exact native command; never fabricate raw radial assignment object
A runtime action present in vanilla but missing from CAM is a functional regression even when all static source checks pass
Radial layout editor and keyboard-only mouse-resize handlers are outside gameplay scope; their removal is deliberate
